Your AniList token is now setup. This token lasts for a year and Librariann will inform you before it expires to refresh it here. manage-metadata-settings.field-mapping-description: Setup rules for certain strings found in Genre/Tag field and map it to a new string in Genre/Tag and optionally remove it from the Source list. manage-metadata-settings.overrides-description: Allow Librariann to write over locked fields.

manage-metadata-settings.language-library-override-description: A library override fully replaces the global order for that library, it does not add to it.

manage-plex-patch.description: Add a Librariann entry to Plex Web's sidebar so you can jump straight into your library without leaving Plex. This is done by a small standalone patcher you run once on the machine hosting Plex Media Server.
manage-plex-patch.address-subtitle: This is the address you are reaching Librariann on right now. Give this to the patcher, as long as the machine running Plex can also reach it.

manage-plex-patch.download-subtitle: Grab the latest release and run it on the machine hosting Plex Media Server.
manage-plex-patch.step-1: Download the patcher onto the Plex machine.
manage-plex-patch.step-3: Browse to and select your Plex Media Server folder. Usually:
manage-plex-patch.step-4: Enter the address shown above as the Librariann Server Address, or use your own domain.
manage-plex-patch.step-6: Add the address you reach Plex at (ip:port, or your domain) to the EmbeddingOrigins list in Librariann's
manage-plex-patch.repatch-note: If Plex updates, or the Librariann icon disappears from Plex's sidebar, just run the patcher again.
manage-plex-patch.tunnel-subtitle: If you want Plex and Librariann reachable from anywhere without exposing your IP or opening ports, set up a free Cloudflare tunnel.
manage-plex-patch.tunnel-step-1: Get a domain and transfer it to Cloudflare (ask an AI for help if this part is confusing).
manage-plex-patch.tunnel-step-2: Go to your Cloudflare account, then Zero Trust > Networks > Tunnels & Mesh.
manage-plex-patch.tunnel-step-3: Pick Create Tunnel in the top right and choose Cloudflared.
manage-plex-patch.tunnel-step-5: Follow their four steps to install Cloudflared and set the tunnel up.
manage-plex-patch.tunnel-step-6: Click next and choose your domain and subdomain.
manage-plex-patch.tunnel-step-7: Point it at the local address of Librariann (http://127.0.0.1:5000) or Plex (http://127.0.0.1:32400).
manage-plex-patch.tunnel-outro: That's it. Be sure to update the patcher and your EmbeddingOrigins to include the new domains.
manage-plex-patch.tunnel-example: You can use one domain for both, for example watch.yourplex.com for Plex and read.yourplex.com for Librariann.
